_about: Medical tree agreed with the owner. Thresholds 0/3/10/15/20. Packed integer ranks travel in the unused native modifiers armored_trap (43) and can_defuse_traps (45: Numb Legs, Take Cover, Unflinching, Concentration); client medical_skills decodes them. Supply Pocket excludes the existing equivalent, Terminator and Additional Medicine; Unflinching and Concentration exclude each other. Native gameplay hooks must ship with this content.
